trip.title: Rotterdam Halloween
trip.subtitle: Late October from Amsterdam to a Rotterdam Halloween night, then Ghent, Damme, and Bruges by rental car.
trip.note: Partner joins in Amsterdam on Friday 10/30. Tuesday sleep in Amsterdam is still being chosen after dinner.

stops.name: Schiphol
stops.description: Land from Copenhagen on the connecting flight and follow the signs to the train hall. The trip on the map starts here, with your partner meeting you on the ground.
tips: Buy or tap for the train before you leave the terminal.
Sloterdijk is one stop toward the city on the Sprinter or Intercity.

stops.name: Holiday Inn Sloterdijk Station
stops.description: Check in at the hotel on the station side of Sloterdijk. Drop the bags, then head back toward the center when you are ready for the first evening.
tips: The front desk can hold bags on Saturday if you check out early for Rotterdam.
One stop on the train puts you at Amsterdam Centraal in a few minutes.

stops.name: Amsterdam evening
stops.description: A short wander through canals and side streets before dinner. Coffee shops and thrift stops if you still have energy.
tips: Trams and trains run late back toward Sloterdijk.

stops.name: Eetcafé De Reiger
stops.description: Classic Jordaan eetcafé on Nieuwe Leliestraat. You asked for a table around half six; treat it as requested until the restaurant confirms.
tips: Kitchen service typically starts a bit after opening.
Walk-ins sometimes find bar seats later in the evening.

stops.name: Holiday Inn Sloterdijk Station
stops.description: First night at Sloterdijk after dinner in the Jordaan. Sleep before the Saturday market run.
tips: Set out anything you need for the Waterlooplein morning.

stops.name: Waterlooplein flea market
stops.description: Outdoor flea market stalls around the square, good for leather jackets and odd finds. Open Monday through Saturday until six.
tips: Bring cash; not every stall takes cards.
Saturday crowds pick up late morning.

stops.name: Episode
stops.description: Thrift floor at the Waterlooplein Episode, a few steps from the market. Dig for jackets and denim before lunch.
tips: Try things on; the good racks turn over fast.

stops.name: Café de Sluyswacht
stops.description: Crooked canal-house café by the Waterlooplein end of town. Lunch at the leaning terrace before you drift south toward the coffeeshops.
tips: The terrace fills on sunny Saturdays.
Book if you want a guaranteed table.

stops.name: Coffeeshop Bluebird
stops.description: Bluebird on Sint Antoniesbreestraat, a few minutes from the Sluyswacht. Slow down before the optional second shop.
tips: ID required; read the menu board before ordering.

stops.name: Original Dampkring
stops.description: Optional detour to the Original Dampkring on Handboogstraat if you still want a second room. Skip it if the clock is tight for the train.
tips: Ten-minute walk west from Bluebird.
Leave time to reach Centraal by four-thirty.

stops.name: Amsterdam Centraal
stops.description: Platforms under the old roof for the Intercity south toward Rotterdam. Aim to tap in before the half-six departure.
tips: Tap out when you leave Rotterdam; OVpay needs a check-out at the gates.
Halloween evening trains can fill up; stand near the doors if it is busy.

stops.name: Rotterdam Centraal
stops.description: Step out under the angular roof into Rotterdam. Drop bags at the Airbnb before dinner at Loos.
tips: Metro and tram stops are on the station square.

stops.name: Rotterdam Airbnb
stops.description: Home base for two nights. Unpack, change for dinner, and save the costume for the rave.
tips: How you get home after the rave is still an open question.

stops.name: Grand Café Loos
stops.description: Booked table at eight at Loos on Westplein, the grand café above the historic Veerhaven. French brasserie energy before Halloween.
tips: Walk or tram from the flat toward the Scheepvaartkwartier.
Leave time to get back and out to the rave.

stops.name: Rotterdam Halloween rave
stops.description: The locked-in Halloween night set, starting at eleven. Dance until you are done—likely well past midnight—then figure out the ride back to the Airbnb.
tips: Earplugs and water are not optional.
Save an offline map for the return trip.

stops.name: Oud-Rotterdamsch Pannenkoekenhuys
stops.description: Optional pancake brunch in Delfshaven if you are awake and the room is serving. Skip straight to Kinderdijk if you sleep in.
tips: Check same-day hours before you cross town.
Delfshaven is a tram ride from the flat.

stops.name: Kinderdijk
stops.description: Windmills along the polder canals after a slow morning. Go before the coach groups if you can.
tips: Reach it by bus and ferry from Rotterdam.
The path is flat and exposed; bring a layer.

stops.name: Rotterdam
stops.description: Afternoon back in the city after the mills: Markthal, cube houses, or the waterfront without a fixed checklist.
tips: Save energy; the car pickup is tomorrow morning.

stops.name: Hotel New York Café-Restaurant
stops.description: Booked dinner at six on Kop van Zuid in the old Holland America Line building. Proper Sunday meal before an optional nightcap.
tips: Walk the Wilhelminakade at blue hour if you arrive early.
Tram back toward Delfshaven afterward.

stops.name: Stadsbrouwerij De Pelgrim
stops.description: Optional walk-in pint at De Pelgrim in Delfshaven if dinner did not run long. Brewery taproom under the church tower.
tips: Last tram times matter if you are staying across the river.
Skip if you need an early Monday.

stops.name: Rotterdam Airbnb
stops.description: Second night in the same flat. Pack a day bag for Monday; the big luggage rides in the car to Bruges.
tips: Set an alarm for the airport pickup.
Charge everything for the driving day.

stops.name: Rotterdam The Hague Airport
stops.description: Pick up the Sixt car at RTM and point it southeast toward Ghent. Traffic and coffee stops belong in the two-and-a-half-hour window.
tips: Photograph the fuel gauge and any existing dents.
Have whoever is not driving ready with navigation.

stops.name: Gravensteen and Graslei
stops.description: The Castle of the Counts, then the Graslei and Korenlei quays for lunch between eleven-thirty and three. Medieval squares instead of motorways.
tips: Castle tickets are worth buying if the queue is moving.
Parking garages sit just outside the pedestrian core.

stops.name: Damme
stops.description: Scenic back roads through Eeklo and Maldegem, then the tree-lined canal and windmill in Damme. The schedule is tight; expect Damme closer to four-ten than four on the dot.
tips: The Meetjesland lanes are pretty but narrow.
Photos beat rushing to the next town.

stops.name: Markt and Burg
stops.description: Park near the ring and walk into the Markt and Burg as the lights come on. Rozenhoedkaai is the postcard angle if you still have daylight.
tips: Leave the car where parking is included with the studio.

stops.name: Bruges studio stay
stops.description: Confirmed private studio with bikes and parking for the rental. Check in, drop bags, and walk back out for dinner.
tips: Host bikes beat haggling with taxis in the morning.
Free parking matters with the car outside.

stops.name: Bierbrasserie Cambrinus
stops.description: Booked table at half six on Philipstockstraat for beer brasserie classics after you are settled in the studio.
tips: Walk from the studio; the center is compact.
Monday nights can fill up fast.

stops.name: Boho Brunch
stops.description: Optional early brunch on Giststraat if you want eggs before the Belfry queue. Skip if you prefer a lighter start.
tips: Kitchen closes mid-afternoon on most days.
Short walk from the studio.

stops.name: Belfry and canals
stops.description: The Belfry opens at ten on winter hours. Canals and Boniface Bridge first if you skipped brunch, then the climb if tickets allow.
tips: Belfry tickets are still on the to-do list.
Last entry is an hour before closing.

stops.name: Lissewege
stops.description: Whitewashed Flemish houses and a village church, twenty minutes from Bruges. A short photo stop before the coast.
tips: Street parking is usually enough.
Respect driveways; people live here.

stops.name: De Fonteintjes
stops.description: Coastal nature walk through dunes, ponds, and reeds toward the North Sea beach. Blocked out from about one-twenty to two-forty-five.
tips: Trails can be sandy; wear shoes you do not mind.
Wind off the sea is colder than Bruges.

stops.name: Blankenberge lighthouse
stops.description: The lighthouse from the outside only; the tower is not open to visitors. Photos and a breath of sea air before the long drive north.
tips: Timing here feeds the three-fifty-hour run to Amsterdam.
Leaving around four-thirty targets a seven-ish arrival at drop-off.

stops.name: Sixt drop-off (De Ruijterkade)
stops.description: Return the rental at the Sixt desk on De Ruijterkade before eleven pm, then walk to Nieuwmarkt for dinner. Fill the tank and keep the receipt.
tips: Allow time for traffic on the A10 ring.
Dinner is booked at eight-thirty nearby.

stops.name: In de Waag
stops.description: Booked dinner at eight-thirty in the old weigh house on Nieuwmarkt. Candlelit rooms after the car is back.
tips: Walk from the drop-off along the canals.
Keep an eye on the time; you still need a bed afterward.

stops.name: Amsterdam (draft)
stops.description: Draft: where to sleep after dinner is not booked yet. Treat this pin as a placeholder near the canal belt until you pick a hotel or flat.
tips: Early night before the ten-thirty flight.
Schiphol is reachable by train from most central stays.

stops.name: Schiphol
stops.description: Check in for the ten-thirty departure to Copenhagen and on to Dulles. Leave the draft stay in time for security on a weekday morning.
tips: SAS Light means paid bags and seats if you want them.
The train from Centraal takes about fifteen minutes when it is running clean.

legs.notes: One stop toward Amsterdam on the Sprinter or Intercity.
Toward Centraal, then walk into the canal belt.
North into the Jordaan for dinner.
Train back to Sloterdijk for the night.
Morning train toward Centraal and the market.
NS Intercity toward Rotterdam, about one hour ten.
Sunday late morning toward Delfshaven if brunch is on.
Skip the brunch leg timing by jumping straight to Kinderdijk if you sleep in.
Back toward the city core.
Metro or taxi toward RTM for the nine o'clock pickup.
Motorway toward Ghent, about two hours twenty with traffic.
Scenic route via Eeklo and Maldegem instead of the highway.
Short hop into Bruges and on foot to the square.
Fifteen kilometers north to the village.
Ten minutes toward the nature reserve.
Ten minutes to the coast.
Long haul to Amsterdam, about three hours twenty with traffic.
Car returned first, then dinner at Nieuwmarkt.
Walk toward wherever Tuesday night lands.
Early train to the airport for the ten-thirty flight.
